description: Get verbatim fenced examples from a page, without running them. Filter by programming language and request/response/guide kind. Returns available_languages, source lines and pagination. No example translation, code execution or live request.

language.description: Exact canonical language from available_languages: curl, javascript, typescript, python, php, go, csharp, java, json, bash, etc.

locale.description: Documentation language: English en, español es, 中文 zh. Required; no cross-language fallback.

page.description: Stable page ID from search/list, e.g. api/balance, rental/default-services, email/providers, sdks or index. A matching relative /en/docs/.../ URL also works.

name: smspva_docs_get_examples
title: Get exact code examples
